name: BUAN Compute Bundles Shapes
summary: Computes shape similarity between bundles of the same type across subjects with the DIPY BUAN (bundle analytics) dipy_buan_shapes workflow.
description: Wraps dipy_buan_shapes, which finds shape similarity between input bundles of the same type across a population, as described in Chandio et al. 2020. The code reads clust_thr, threshold and subject_folder from config.json, but no inputs or parameters are registered for this App.

citations.text: Chandio BQ, et al. Bundle analytics, a computational framework for investigating the shapes and profiles of brain pathways across populations. Scientific Reports 10, 17149 (2020).
